# Benchmark results

<!-- Generated by `fusion bench results live-headline` on 2026-10-06. Do not edit by hand: rerun the command. -->

Generated on 2026-10-06 from run `live-headline`. The verdicts below are the verdict engine's text, unedited; how to read them is in [BENCHMARKING.md](BENCHMARKING.md#statistics-reports-and-how-to-read-them).

The full report with its charts is [benchmark-report.html](benchmark-report.html).

> 25 job(s) halted on their first attempt (a call timed out or the panel had no quorum) and were run again, with longer timeouts where it was a timeout: solo-frontier (3), solo-luna (1), solo-sol (21). Only the last attempt is scored; the first attempt's cost is in the totals. A halted job scores 0, so without the retry these arms would be understated by the harness's limit, not by their answers.
> Items replayed from the response cache are left out of the latency figures (solo-luna, fusion-best, fusion-default): their wall time is not a measurement.
> 2 repeat(s) per task: variance across repeats is poorly estimated.
> Frontend and performance scores measure what the answer builds (tests, timings, screenshots); they do not judge whether it matches the author's intent.

## Methodology

- **Run:** live-headline (completed), created 2026-10-06 13:35:44
- **Dataset:** evals/datasets/v1, split test, 34 tasks, hash 837fe0ce929013ba
- **Arm solo-frontier:** strategy solo-frontier: solo, models claude-opus, aggregator llm, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm solo-sol:** strategy solo-sol: solo, models gpt-sol, aggregator llm, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm solo-haiku:** strategy solo-cheap: solo, models claude-haiku, aggregator llm, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm solo-luna:** strategy solo-luna: solo, models gpt-luna, aggregator llm, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm fusion-default:** strategy panel-cheap: panel, models claude-haiku, gpt-luna, gemini-flash, synthesizer claude-haiku, aggregator llm, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm fusion-best:** strategy panel-cheap, overrides {'members': [{'model': 'claude-haiku'}, {'model': 'gpt-luna'}]}: panel, models claude-haiku, gpt-luna, synthesizer claude-haiku, aggregator llm, rounds 1, judge off
- **Model claude-opus:** anthropic claude-opus-5-5: $4 in / $20 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-10-05
- **Model gpt-sol:** openai gpt-6.1-sol: $2 in / $10 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-10-05
- **Model claude-haiku:** anthropic claude-haiku-4-5-20251001: $1 in / $5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-10-05
- **Model gpt-luna:** openai gpt-6-luna: $0.1 in / $0.5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-10-05
- **Model gemini-flash:** google gemini-3.8-flash: $0.75 in / $3.75 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-10-05
- **Judge models:** gpt-luna
- **Repeats / seed:** 2 per task / seed 100
- **Intervals:** 95% percentile bootstrap, 2000 resamples of tasks (repeats are not independent); comparisons are paired on the tasks both arms were scored on
- **Verdict rules:** non-inferiority margin 0.03 quality; at least 10 paired tasks; a task is a tie when the arms differ by at most 0.02; baseline solo-frontier
- **Spend:** $9.56 on the arms + $0.0512 on scoring and judging (cap $11.00)
- **Fusion version:** 0.1.0


## Supporting study: live-ablation

Arms: size-1, size-2, synth-strong, size-5, size-3, cascade-0.5, cascade-0.7, refine-on, self-haiku, self-luna. Baseline for the comparisons: size-1.

> The run is stopped (146/150 jobs finished; max_usd reached: $4.7591 of $4.80 spent and the next job may cost up to $0.0467): arms may have answered different tasks.
> Some prices were unknown for self-luna: its costs are a lower bound.
> Items replayed from the response cache are left out of the latency figures (synth-strong, size-5, cascade-0.5, cascade-0.7, refine-on, self-haiku): their wall time is not a measurement.
> 1 repeat(s) per task: variance across repeats is poorly estimated.
> Frontend and performance scores measure what the answer builds (tests, timings, screenshots); they do not judge whether it matches the author's intent.

### Methodology

- **Run:** live-ablation (stopped), created 2026-10-06 13:17:34
- **Dataset:** evals/datasets/v1, split dev, 15 tasks, hash 1ce5c41a388ccfd6
- **Arm size-3:** strategy panel-cheap: panel, models claude-haiku, gpt-luna, gemini-flash, synthesizer claude-haiku, aggregator llm, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm size-1:** strategy solo-cheap: solo, models claude-haiku, aggregator llm, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm size-2:** strategy panel-cheap, overrides {'members': [{'model': 'claude-haiku'}, {'model': 'gpt-luna'}]}: panel, models claude-haiku, gpt-luna, synthesizer claude-haiku, aggregator llm, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm size-5:** strategy panel-cheap, overrides {'members': [{'model': 'claude-haiku'}, {'model': 'gpt-luna'}, {'model': 'gemini-flash'}, {'model': 'gpt-luna-security'}, {'model': 'claude-haiku-s2', 'temperature': 0.7}]}: panel, models claude-haiku, gpt-luna, gemini-flash, gpt-luna-security, claude-haiku-s2, synthesizer claude-haiku, aggregator llm, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm refine-on:** strategy panel-refine: panel, models claude-haiku, gpt-luna, gemini-flash, synthesizer claude-haiku, aggregator llm, rounds 2, judge off
- **Arm synth-strong:** strategy panel-cheap-strong-synth: panel, models claude-haiku, gpt-luna, gemini-flash, synthesizer claude-sonnet, aggregator llm, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm cascade-0.5:** strategy panel-cascade, overrides {'cascade': {'agreement_threshold': 0.5}}: cascade, models claude-haiku, gpt-luna, gemini-flash, synthesizer claude-sonnet, aggregator llm, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm cascade-0.7:** strategy panel-cascade: cascade, models claude-haiku, gpt-luna, gemini-flash, synthesizer claude-sonnet, aggregator llm, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm self-haiku:** strategy panel-cheap, overrides {'members': [{'model': 'claude-haiku', 'temperature': 0.3}, {'model': 'claude-haiku-s2', 'temperature': 0.7}, {'model': 'claude-haiku-s3', 'temperature': 1.0}], 'aggregator_model': 'claude-haiku'}: panel, models claude-haiku, claude-haiku-s2, claude-haiku-s3, synthesizer claude-haiku, aggregator llm, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm self-luna:** strategy panel-cheap, overrides {'members': [{'model': 'gpt-luna', 'reasoning_effort': 'low'}, {'model': 'gpt-luna-s2', 'reasoning_effort': 'medium'}, {'model': 'gpt-luna-s3', 'reasoning_effort': 'high'}], 'aggregator_model': 'gpt-luna'}: panel, models gpt-luna, gpt-luna-s2, gpt-luna-s3, synthesizer gpt-luna, aggregator llm, rounds 1, judge off
- **Model claude-haiku:** anthropic claude-haiku-4-5-20251001: $1 in / $5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-10-05
- **Model gpt-luna:** openai gpt-6-luna: $0.1 in / $0.5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-10-05
- **Model gemini-flash:** google gemini-3.8-flash: $0.75 in / $3.75 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-10-05
- **Model gpt-luna-security:** openai gpt-6-luna: $0.1 in / $0.5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-10-05
- **Model claude-haiku-s2:** anthropic claude-haiku-4-5-20251001: $1 in / $5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-10-05
- **Model claude-sonnet:** anthropic claude-sonnet-5-5: $2 in / $10 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-10-05
- **Model claude-haiku-s3:** anthropic claude-haiku-4-5-20251001: $1 in / $5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-10-05
- **Model gpt-luna-s2:** openai gpt-6-luna: $0.1 in / $0.5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-10-05
- **Model gpt-luna-s3:** openai gpt-6-luna: $0.1 in / $0.5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-10-05
- **Judge models:** gpt-luna
- **Repeats / seed:** 1 per task / seed 0
- **Intervals:** 95% percentile bootstrap, 2000 resamples of tasks (repeats are not independent); comparisons are paired on the tasks both arms were scored on
- **Verdict rules:** non-inferiority margin 0.03 quality; at least 10 paired tasks; a task is a tie when the arms differ by at most 0.02; baseline size-1
- **Spend:** $4.84 on the arms + $0.0222 on scoring and judging (cap $4.80)
- **Fusion version:** 0.1.0


## Supporting study: live-latency

Arms: early-return, wait-for-all, hedged, cascade. Baseline for the comparisons: early-return.

> Some prices were unknown for early-return, hedged: its costs are a lower bound.
> 1 repeat(s) per task: variance across repeats is poorly estimated.
> Fewer than 10 tasks are answered by both an arm and the baseline: no verdict is possible for it.

### Methodology

- **Run:** live-latency (completed), created 2026-10-06 13:29:26
- **Dataset:** evals/datasets/v1, split dev, 9 tasks, hash 67dcd1d278267315
- **Arm wait-for-all:** strategy panel-cheap: panel, models claude-haiku, gpt-luna, gemini-flash, synthesizer claude-haiku, aggregator llm, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm early-return:** strategy panel-cheap, overrides {'fanout': {'early_return': {'quorum': 2, 'grace_ms': 1500}}}: panel, models claude-haiku, gpt-luna, gemini-flash, synthesizer claude-haiku, aggregator llm, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm hedged:** strategy panel-cheap, overrides {'fanout': {'hedge_after_ms': 8000}}: panel, models claude-haiku, gpt-luna, gemini-flash, synthesizer claude-haiku, aggregator llm, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm cascade:** strategy panel-cascade: cascade, models claude-haiku, gpt-luna, gemini-flash, synthesizer claude-sonnet, aggregator llm, rounds 1, judge off
- **Model claude-haiku:** anthropic claude-haiku-4-5-20251001: $1 in / $5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-10-05
- **Model gpt-luna:** openai gpt-6-luna: $0.1 in / $0.5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-10-05
- **Model gemini-flash:** google gemini-3.8-flash: $0.75 in / $3.75 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-10-05
- **Model claude-sonnet:** anthropic claude-sonnet-5-5: $2 in / $10 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-10-05
- **Judge models:** none (deterministic scorers only)
- **Repeats / seed:** 1 per task / seed 0
- **Intervals:** 95% percentile bootstrap, 2000 resamples of tasks (repeats are not independent); comparisons are paired on the tasks both arms were scored on
- **Verdict rules:** non-inferiority margin 0.03 quality; at least 10 paired tasks; a task is a tie when the arms differ by at most 0.02; baseline early-return
- **Spend:** $1.07 on the arms + $0 on scoring and judging (cap $1.20)
- **Fusion version:** 0.1.0

## Limitations

- **The tasks are synthetic.** An LLM drafted them and they were not reviewed by a person; see
  [evals/datasets/README.md](../evals/datasets/README.md#provenance-and-validity-read-this-before-quoting-a-number).
  They test whether an answer finds the seeded defect, names the root cause or passes the hidden
  tests, not how an answer feels in a real project.
- **It is a small study.** The $20 budget caps it at a few dozen tasks and a few repeats, so
  the intervals are wide and many verdicts are *inconclusive*. That is a result: the study could
  not tell, which is not the same as the arms being equal.
- **The scorers decide the numbers.** Review, debugging and rubric scores come from keyword and
  structure matching with a cheap LLM judge for what they cannot settle; no judge is from a
  different vendor than every arm (each vendor sits on a panel), so it may favour its own style.
  Frontend and performance scores are measured (tests, timings, accessibility), not judged by a
  model, and they check structure and speed, not intent or taste.
- **Prices and speeds are those of the day.** Costs use the catalog's prices (dates in the
  methodology); latencies depend on provider load at the time of the run.
- **One dataset, one set of models.** A different task mix, a newer model or another judge can
  change a verdict. The tuning used the `dev` split and this report is from the held-out `test`
  split, but both come from the same author and generator.
- **Claude Code is not in the loop.** Fusion's `digest` aggregation hands the merge to the
  calling model; in a study the panel's digest is scored as it is, with no model merging it.

## Reproduce

```bash
uv run fusion bench report live-headline --format html
uv run fusion bench results live-headline --also live-ablation --also live-latency --html docs/benchmark-report.html --svg docs/assets/benchmark-cost-quality.svg
```
